easyPrerequisites:
You control your commander.
There's an artifact on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.
